summary: Lipocine filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing that Health Canada approved TLANDO (testosterone undecanoate) capsules for testosterone replacement therapy in adult males, announced October 7, 2026. Approval was obtained through licensing partner Verity Pharmaceuticals, which holds exclusive North American commercial rights under a January 2024 license agreement and plans Canadian launch by end-2026. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine regulatory/product milestone, not a special situation; watch commercialization timing and royalty economics, not arbitrage.
